minutes.headline: Select Board voted 4-1 to put TC Passios rehab and new-build design-funding articles on the special town meeting warrant.
minutes.summary: The board spent most of the meeting debating the TC Passios reuse committee's proposed warrant articles for the November 16 special town meeting. It approved articles J, K and L, with one member opposed, and renewed a bond anticipation note. It also discussed the old primary school demolition, which was tabled a week, plus FY22 budget updates and a hardship ambulance bill.

what_happened.line: The Select Board voted 4-1 to put articles K and L, the TC Passios rehab and new-build design-funding items, on the special town meeting warrant, subject to amending L.
The board unanimously added article J, the TC Passios building design committee's report, to the warrant.
Members said on the record that if K fails and L passes, they would vote to expand the TC Passios committee's charge.
The board approved signing the renewal of a bond anticipation note for the Saliva property and the ladder truck.
Discussion of demolishing the old primary school was tabled a week; the town manager is to ask whether the APDC chair's position against a pavilion is official.

why_it_matters: Articles K and L would ask voters at the November 16 special town meeting to fund design work on the TC Passios building, a debt-financed project whose borrowing a resident said could strain the town's debt capacity alongside Turkey Hill.
The design-documents funding, discussed as needing a transfer from stabilization or reserve, with free cash also raised as a source, would draw on town savings rather than a new tax line.
watch_next: The November 16 special town meeting vote on articles J, K and L, including the amendment to L.
Next week's Select Board return to the old primary school demolition, after the town manager asks the APDC chair about its pavilion position.

reconciliation.what: Our minutes against the minutes the town published. caption_error = the same fact the captions rendered badly, resolved by the official reading shown beside the as-heard one; discrepancy = a substantive difference, flagged and not resolved. Neither record is treated as the referee.
reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on the BAN renewal, Article J, the senior work-off policy and most budget figures. They differ on the K/L vote's terms, the ambulance hardship amount, and who was assigned to contact the APDC and who to contact about civics. The thing to know is that the K/L vote tally matches (4-1), but ours says only L could be amended, the official minutes say either could, and the official minutes add that Jeffreys withdrew his K motion, which ours never mentions.
